observation: During WP-M3D-5 repair execution, subagent 1 failed abruptly with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (HTTP code 429 quota reached) due to context inflation and repetitive tool calls. The orchestrator lacked a formal protocol for handling subagent quota failure, needing ad-hoc recovery by spawning a new repair subagent with a tighter prompt.
proposed_change: Formalize Subagent Failure & Quota Recovery Protocol in docs/PROTOCOLS.md (§11c): enforce fail-fast termination on 429/timeout, zero master context contamination, prompt/scope compaction, and clean isolated re-dispatch to alternate endpoints or tighter scopes (max 1 retry before formal Principal escalation).
expected_benefit: Prevents cascading failures, eliminates session deadlocks from quota exhaustion, and standardizes automated recovery without manual orchestrator improvisation.
possible_counterexamples: If all available provider quotas are simultaneously exhausted, re-dispatch will fail immediately and require Principal/Human intervention.
evaluation_plan: Simulate quota exhaustion in staging/testbeds and verify clean re-dispatch and escalation behavior.
rollback_plan: Remove §11c quota recovery procedure from PROTOCOLS.md.
